api_key.settings.apiKeyAllowedEnvironmen: Comma-separated environment namespaces baked into the raw-key prefix (e.g. live, test, staging). Documents which environments your integrations may mint keys for. Leave blank to use the built-in live/test defaults.
api_key.settings.apiKeyDefaultRateLimitP: Default maximum verifications per minute for each key. 0 = unlimited.
api_key.settings.apiKeyMaxActiveKeys.des: Maximum number of active API keys this tenant may hold at once. 0 = unlimited.
api_key.settings.apiKeyMaxTtlDays.descri: Cap on how far in the future a key may be set to expire. Every key expires: 90 days by default, at most 365. A lower number here lowers both; 0 = the 365-day platform cap.
api_key.settings.apiKeyMaxTtlDays.label: Maximum Key Lifetime (days)
api_key.settings.apiKeyNegativeCacheTtlS: How long to cache a "no such API key" result, in seconds. Minimum 60. Platform-wide value (read from the root tenant).
api_key.settings.apiKeyRequireExpiry.des: Every new key expires (90 days unless a date is given). When enabled, an API call that creates a key must name its expiry date instead of taking the 90-day default.
api_key.settings.apiKeyTenantIpAllowlist: Comma/space-separated subnets (CIDR) applied as a default to every key that does not declare its own allowlist. A single host is a /32 (e.g. 192.168.1.182/32). Leave blank to allow all.
api_key.settings.subtitle: Lifecycle, network and environment policy for API key lookups

api_key.createModal.expiryHint: 90 days by default, at most a year.
api_key.createModal.integrationScopesHel: For machine endpoints with their own contract, such as SCIM provisioning. Module permissions above are what most integrations need.
api_key.createModal.ipAllowlistHint: One subnet per line, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8 or 203.0.113.7/32. Empty: any address the workspace allows.

api_key.detail.reviewMessage: This key was created before keys had per-module permissions. It keeps working with its integration scopes. Give it only the module permissions it needs and drop the scopes it does not use, or keep it as it is.
api_key.detail.reviewNoExpiry: It never expires: reviewing it (here or by changing its access) gives it 90 days, or the workspace's lower limit.
api_key.detail.scopesNarrowHelp: Scopes can only be removed here; a key that needs wider ones is a new key.
